apply_distortion: apply radial or OpenCV distortion to 2D image points using batched distortion parameters
single_undistortion: apply single-step undistortion to normalized camera tracks given distortion parameters
iterative_undistortion: iteratively undistort normalized camera tracks using Newton-Raphson with numerical Jacobian
ensure_torch: convert numpy arrays or Python scalars to PyTorch tensors for downstream computation
test_distortion: test distortion module against pycolmap SIMPLE_RADIAL camera model for correctness
